text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That was a great, flawless victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the "Empress,"
I must always strive to carry myself this way.
choice_data_list: Don't let your guard down, you hear?
Don't let your guard down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the "Empress,"
I must always strive to carry myself this way.
choice_data_list: Don't let your guard down, you hear?
Don't let your guard down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too carried away.
It's just one win. This isn't the end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Brace yourself and stay focused for our next race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I did not say you couldn't be happy.
I merely meant you should keep it in moderation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I constantly hold myself to the highest standard as the 'Empress.'
I will never let my guard down."
choice_data_list: You seem even more cheerful than usual, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... Even I can't help cracking a smile
upon victory every now and thenâ

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
After telling everyone not to let their guard down,
you are the one slacking off the most!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A perfect opportunity to straighten out that lazy attitude of yours!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I received a lecture,
but even while being scolded, her expression
was gentler than usual.
